verdict.rationale: Metronome's docs mention bearer token authentication and token creation via the app (metronome-docs-3, metronome-docs-17), but there is no evidence of scoped permissions, role-based access, or least-privilege credential issuance—let alone anything tailored for AI agents. The axis is applicable since API credentialing is a normal feature for a billing API, but no evidence supports the scoped/least-privilege capability.
